description: A line to an athlete, attached to a session or a week — never a free chat. It shows on their Today card, under the session or above the week, and in the morning email. For a reply they sent, use answer_message instead so the reply is marked done.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

week_start.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the Monday of the week it is about, when it is not about one session

name: send_message
